name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
description: Searches, summarizes and assembles clips from your video and image library in plain language, for teams working in Claude, ChatGPT, or the Agents API.

skills.name: Cross-Video Search
skills.description: Finds clips across a knowledge store that match a natural-language query, ranked by relevance and filterable by metadata.

skills.name: Answers with Citations
skills.description: Answers questions about a video collection in text that links to the exact clips each answer draws from.

skills.name: Highlight Reel Assembly
skills.description: Finds and sequences clips around a theme, topic, or criteria into a curated highlight reel or playlist.

skills.name: Entity Tracking
skills.description: Follows a person, place, brand, or object across videos and builds a chronological timeline of appearances with timestamps.

skills.name: Streaming Responses
skills.description: Streams generated response text as events, with optional multi-turn sessions and structured JSON output.
